column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT je.entry_date AS TransactionDate, je.transaction_id AS TransactionId, gl.gl_code AS AccountCode, gl.name AS AccountName, CASE WHEN je.type_enum = 1 THEN 'CREDIT' WHEN je.type_enum = 2 THEN 'DEBIT' END AS EntryType, je.amount AS Amount, je.description AS Description, o.name AS OfficeName, je.ref_num AS ReferenceNumber, COALESCE(ml.account_no, '') AS LoanAccountNumber FROM acc_gl_journal_entry je JOIN acc_gl_account gl ON je.account_id = gl.id JOIN m_office o ON je.office_id = o.id LEFT JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = je.entity_id AND je.entity_type_enum = 1 WHERE je.entry_date >= '${startDate}' AND je.entry_date <= '${endDate}' AND (je.office_id = ${officeId} OR ${officeId} = -1) AND (${loanId} = -1 OR ml.id = ${loanId}) AND je.reversed = false ORDER BY je.entry_date, je.transaction_id, je.type_enum
